matched_pretraining_environment_evidence.intervention: old Harrier mixture versus the selected mixture-swap schedule

development_comparison.common_start: all six runs restore the same step-393 checkpoint after 10 percent baseline training
development_comparison.boundary: the selected mixture was chosen using the swarm, so this is development evidence rather than independent validation

matched_pretraining_environment_evidence.contract_difference: the d512 swarm continues from 10 percent baseline training, while the larger mixture-swap ladder starts the selected schedule after 25 percent; cross-scale results are therefore a stress test rather than an identical-contract validation
matched_pretraining_environment_evidence.allowed_use: stress-test cross-scale environment representation, native-target changes, and transfer scoring before the post-training study
matched_pretraining_environment_evidence.disallowed_use: claim that pretraining mixture transfer establishes RL environment transfer or a prospective Mochi result

post_training_bridge.family_evidence: Marin describes Snowball as a smaller Grug MoE using the same post-training stack as Mochi
post_training_bridge.available_evidence: multiple SFT and RL campaigns, released checkpoints, public recipes, evaluation records, and cost records
post_training_bridge.role: retrospective development and matched prospective panel

post_training_bridge.family_evidence: Mochi SFT starts from the completed Hero checkpoint lineage
post_training_bridge.available_evidence: one broad RL campaign with sealed evaluation, holdout curves, recipe, and runtime records

separate_method_check.evidence: 27 midtraining mixture-by-scale cells and completed SFT and RL evaluations across the public Delphi ladder
separate_method_check.allowed_use: test archive parsing, scale features, uncertainty, and scoring without choosing the Grug-family transfer rule

conclusion.minimum_new_evidence: verify durable checkpoints and post-training compatibility for the three completed narrow rungs, then run one fixed SFT and RL candidate contract on at least one additional rung before calling the result a three-scale post-training trend; the incomplete d2048 rung is not eligible as a matched final checkpoint
conclusion.protected_target: Mochi outcomes cannot select the measurement transform, candidate construction rule, surrogate route, or abstention rule
